name: Lens
subtitle: Lens camera builds
description: Builds of the Lens camera app.

apps.name: Lens
apps.subtitle: Native iPhone camera
apps.localizedDescription: Native iPhone camera with PNG and RAW capture, Portrait and Low Light modes.
apps.versionDescription:
- Fixed: the camera-switch flip now stays inside the viewfinder frame. It no longer spills over the top bar and the controls below.
- Reverted: the camera-switch button no longer spins.
- Fixed: Portrait now saves only the blurred photo instead of two. If no depth data is available, it saves one normal photo and says so.
